source: Live licensed TallyPrime 7.1 Silver read of the company ledger-count request, render_company_ledger_count_request("BRIDGE SIZE 2K") (bridge#938): the Company collection fetching Name, GUID and NUMLEDGERS. The collection answers for every loaded company whatever SVCURRENTCOMPANY says; 31 companies were loaded and every row carried NUMLEDGERS
transformation: the company rows of 28 of the 31 loaded companies removed, leaving three synthetic lab companies (an ageing lab, a dense corpus and the 4,339-ledger size book); every byte of the envelope and of the kept rows is as captured, the separators between rows included
provenance_limit: A live response sent once (not a paired read) from a licensed TallyPrime 7.1 Silver holding only synthetic lab companies, 30 Sep 2026 22:33 IST, reads only. Establishes that this request is answered with a status 1 Company collection, that each row is NAME, GUID and NUMLEDGERS in that order with the count as ` <digits>` (a leading space), and that the count of the 4,339-ledger book equals the ledger catalogue and AlterID-span census counts of the same book (4,339); the same field was present on all 31 rows. It does not establish what NUMLEDGERS counts for a book with deleted or hidden ledgers, nor how any other Tally version answers; the rows of the other 28 companies are not in the fixture, so it is not the byte-exact response.
sensitivity_review: Operator-created synthetic lab companies (names and GUIDs of lab companies only); the company names of the removed rows are not recorded anywhere in this tree; no GSTIN, PAN, email, phone, address, URL, credentials or machine paths.
